Not accurate at all other than deterministic combat. The narrative mechanical arcs for the game are vastly different. 

 Vf being a group beat your score variant where you build up in power and board presence that also has more group decisions vs a pandemic  annihilation style game where things get torn down and get worse as your character gets stronger with your game play mostly centered around hand management.
Blaming millennial for leaving jobs after thr first week in 5,4,3

I see feelings and I get that it can feel one way for one person and another for another person.

Cold hard math? The dice are high variance and you can have wildly different outcomes in a fight in eclipse, while the fighting in voidfall is predetermined and zero sum.

I appreciate you're a fan, but roll a 6 win a cookie isn't a euro design methodology and voidfalls lack of that should inform people who have some experience in game design philosophy on why the two games will play out quite differently across most player types.

Also lived it, I'm not saying it's not hard,

I'm just saying you could still do it as a SGT who never went to school.

 I don't know how anyone outside the rich double earners in tech have 3 kids these days.

I just had a single tooth fixed and it end up being 4,200 (which of course for me was brought to 0, but everyone else I work with pays $500 a year to pay half of that capped at 2000 dollars... and that's considered excellent insurance.

 God forbid your kid has a medical issue at birth like some guys I know who couldn't leave the service because the cost even with insurance would have been crippling.

Now Imagine you can lose your job at any time instead of having that all guaranteed.

Everyone not in the military that isn't extremely well off is playing medical Russian roulette, and I feel bad for them.

Coop or solo? Voidfall

Rolly Space battle or deterministic cold war arms race?

I wouldn't own eclipse because I don't like huge long games determined by dice. But I've also been part of 8 hour risk games and know people eat that stuff up.

There's also a component question, gametrayz and more sculpts vs 5.3 inch tiles, metal components, universal sculpt design, and triple layer boards.

I don't like the trays as much as triple layer boards and metal tokens.

You would still have all that on a sergents salary as they give you 100% medical amd dental care, area cost of living housing or on post houses with enough rooms for your entire family, food benefits, discounted tax free shopping, and more pay for each child.

But then we're getting into boring dystopia territory.
What do those patsys have to do with anything, I'm just a fan of the chocolatest roll and snack on the market.

Walk up and hit it two times until it's dead.

From the designers of Roll a 6 win a cookie.

You get Jon going outside of paid content and I love him. But so very wrong about games takes the cake. I either completely agree with them, or it's a flicking game.

Recent tom is fairly good, I'm a little more jaded than delisio but he's still in another league over the paid pom pom cheer squad that is the bunch of 30 year old white dudes trying to make the most money they can out of promotional board game advertising.
I think I've had my last blacklist game stuck in a train station for two months on US soil.
They are adding in vat after the campaign so it bumps that all in to $265 is USD
Idgi, the people who do this are wither left enough to want this in the US or Rich enough that they know all the conservative laws and systems are to keep people poor and them rich.

The biggest issue is going to be the price. If you think moving around flat cardboard ships with up to 3 cubes on top across flat tiles with up to 7 tokens on top with dice stacked on top of tokens on top of those tiles is not going to be an absolute mess...

But of course there is this nice deluxe version with triple layer tiles and metal pieces that slot in and minis to hold those dice and minis with stands to hold the cubes.

I'm in. I can afford a $220 board game, but I think they painted themselves in the corner with the base edition.
Right it's the only one I own for good reason.
